From the judge's explanation

Both sides' accounts of the timing agree, and the arithmetic decides this case. The driver tapped 'I'm Here' at 06:28:20 and the free waiting period of 180 seconds in force for this STANDARD pickup began at 06:28:22 (EV-TRIP-02730, platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180). The GPS trace (EV-GPS-02730) places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius for a single continuous run of 79 seconds, from 06:28:20 to 06:29:39, and the trip was terminated at 06:29:42. The effective in-geofence dwell of 79 seconds is 101 seconds short of the required 180 seconds. Under POL-NS-06 the cancellation fee is therefore not chargeable and is refunded in full: the 4.50 SGD cancellation_fee line on EV-FARE-02730, which is the whole contested amount, with no booking or platform fee to consider on a trip that never started. The same arithmetic fails POL-NS-01 limb (c) (continuous dwell short of the free waiting period) and limb (d) (the termination at 06:29:42 came before the required dwell would have elapsed at 06:31:20), so the fee cannot stand on the baseline clause either. Nothing rescues the shortfall by accumulation: the only advisory, EV-ADVIS-02730-01, is MISSING, carries weight 0.0 and the MISSING_ARTIFACT issue code, and can carry no fact; independently the trace shows a single in-geofence interval (run_count 1), so POL-NS-06(i) has no second interval to add. The driver's arrival marker was not false — he was stationary at the pin at 06:28:20 — so POL-NS-05 and its false-arrival referral do not apply. No driver compensation is payable: POL-NS-07 is conditioned on POL-NS-01 being satisfied in full, which it is not, and the anti-farming check does not trip in any event (driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d = 1 against a threshold of 4, rate 1/65 = 0.015 against 0.08). On the rider's POL-NS-04 claims — the single chat message 'coming out now' at 06:29:20, the driver's silence, and the rider's device sitting within 23.2 m of the pin across all 30 qualifying fixes — the point does not change the outcome, because whether or not limb (a) is met, POL-NS-06 already refunds the fee in full with no compensation. The driver's reference to the rider's no-show history is context only: POL-GEN-01 makes prior_no_show_flags (6) a lifetime counter that cannot ground any finding, and the citable field rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1, below POL-NS-09(d)'s threshold of 3, so no escalation follows; the driver's statement does not move the case. No artifact is impaired under POL-NS-08(a)–(d): the arrival timestamp matches its nearest GPS fix, the trace has no gaps and full 100% coverage, the chat count matches trip_record.chat_message_count, and the 4.50 SGD fare line reconciles to the net fee produced by the resolution rule, so confidence is not capped. The monetary effect of 4.50 SGD is below the 8.00 SGD execution threshold of POL-GEN-05 and executes automatically.

How to appeal: Either party may appeal once within 30 days. A different human reviewer hears it, and only record evidence may be added.

POL-GEN-05: the monetary effect is SGD 4.50 against an execution threshold of SGD 8.00. It does not exceed the threshold, so the amount is executed automatically on issue, subject to POL-GEN-04.

Read POL-GEN-04 in full
Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

This is a NO_SHOW_CHARGE dispute over the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee (EV-FARE-02730: cancellation_fee line 4.50, total_charged 4.50, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00). Both of you read the arithmetic the same way, and so do I. WHAT THE DRIVER GOT RIGHT. The driver genuinely arrived and did not false-tap. EV-GPS-02730 places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius at 06:28:20, the same instant as the trip_record 'I'm Here' event (EV-TRIP-02730), so POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (b) hold and the POL-NS-05 false-arrival branch is not engaged (his speed at the marker was 0.0 km/h, and he was inside the radius, not merely within 300 m). His termination was recorded under RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three codes POL-NS-01(d) recognises, so the DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE problem that clause polices is absent and no 'mis-selected reason code' referral arises. WHY THE FEE NONETHELESS COMES BACK. The charge turns on the dwell, and the dwell is short. The qualifying in-geofence run is 79 seconds (06:28:20 to 06:29:39, 9 fixes); the free waiting period in force is 180 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec); the shortfall is 101 seconds. The driver cancelled at 06:29:42, well before the required dwell would have elapsed at 06:31:20. So POL-NS-01 limb (c) fails, and limb (d) fails with it, because a termination before the dwell has run is not a termination 'at or after' it. Under POL-NS-06 the cancellation fee is therefore not chargeable and is refunded to the rider in full. Nothing rescues the shortfall by accumulation: the only advisory, EV-ADVIS-02730-01, is MISSING (weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT) and can carry no fact, and in any event the trace shows a single in-geofence interval (run_count 1), so POL-NS-06(i) has nothing to add. Because the advisory is absent rather than asserted, POL-NS-09 is not triggered by it. POL-NS-04. The rider's one message, 'coming out now' (06:29:20), went unanswered and the rider's device sat within 23.2 m of the pin (all 30 qualifying rider fixes inside the 100 m radius). Whether that message is a 'locating or coordinating' message within limb (a) is arguable, but it changes nothing: the fee is refunded in full under POL-NS-06 whether or not POL-NS-04 opens, and neither route carries driver compensation. DRIVER COMPENSATION. POL-NS-07 pays only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it; POL-NS-06 displaces it here, so no compensation is payable. The anti-farming check does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d is 1 and completed_trips_30d is 65, far below the 4-and-0.08 test), and no POL-NS-03 pin-ambiguity goodwill applies because the driver's stationary fixes were inside the arrival radius, not at a wrong entrance. The driver reached the pickup pin at Blk 640 Jurong West St 61 at 06:28:20, held position inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius for a single continuous run of 79 seconds (9 qualifying fixes, 06:28:20 to 06:29:39, closest approach 0.16 m), and terminated the trip at 06:29:42 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW. The free waiting period in force for this trip is 180 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec). POL-NS-01 is conjunctive and both limb (c) (dwell) and limb (d) (termination at or after the required dwell) fail on the driver's own evidence (EV-TRIP-02730, EV-GPS-02730), so the fee is not chargeable under POL-NS-01 and POL-NS-07 driver compensation is unavailable, being conditioned on POL-NS-01 being satisfied in full.
